text:
maria_s: Escalation from Acme Ops (Jai) — after the 03/16 rollout they're seeing function/tool calls return with missing or empty args. Customer reports started ~22:20 UTC and affects production. Pasting their minimal repro below.

acme_ops_jai: repro curl we run against /v1/chat/completions:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-llm-v2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Create a ticket for payment failure"}],"functions":[{"name":"create_ticket","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string"},"amount":{"type":"number"}}}}],"function_call":"auto"}'
```

acme_ops_jai: expected -> model should call create_ticket with args: {"summary":"Payment failed for invoice 1234","amount":199.99}
actual -> model responds with: {"name":"create_ticket","args": null} OR args returned as literal string "{summary: 'Payment...'}" (incorrectly formatted/truncated).

maria_s: attaching customer logs they shared (redacted request IDs). They say ~60% of calls return malformed/missing args since the rollout.

deploy-bot: Notice: rollout rld-239 reached 100% stable at 2026-03-16T22:15:03Z (sha a1b2c3d4).

raj_engine: assigning to me. Thanks for the repro. Quick Qs: can you paste the response body (raw) including any top-level "finish_reason" and whether the response contained a tool call event or only assistant message? Also send x-request-id header values from your logs so we can trace.

acme_ops_jai: raw response (redacted):
```json
{"id":"resp_abc123","object":"chat.completion","choices":[{"finish_reason":"function_call","message":{"role":"assistant","content":null,"function_call":{"name":"create_ticket","arguments":null}}}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":60,"completion_tokens":12}}
```

raj_engine: OK this matches what I thought. We rolled a formatting change to the tool-call serializer in the runtime with rld-239. Under certain nested parameter shapes the serializer returned JSON null or stringified/truncated arguments. Repro locally with the same payload. Temp mitigation for customers: pin model to "redwood-llm-v1" or set header `x-redwood-model-variant: legacy-formatter` which forces the old formatting path. Also as a workaround, set `function_call: \"none\"` and perform tool selection client-side until we patch.

olivia_prod: CUSTOMER IMPACT? If it's 60% of production traffic for Acme and they have 800 rps, this is high. Do we rollback rld-239 to previous stable or push hotfix? Need recommendation within 30m.

acme_ops_jai: confirmed ~800 req/min to our tool endpoints, roughly 50-70% malformed since 22:20. They want rollback — they're degrading UX and will throttle traffic.

raj_engine: I recommend partial rollback: move rld-239 to canary=0 in us-west-2 immediately and keep other regions under observation. I'll open hotfix branch to revert the serializer change and run tests against nested schemas. If rollback isn't possible for them (managed infra), we can suggest header workaround.

sre_ann: created alert INC-789: toolcall_argument_error_rate spike >50% in prod; paging on-call.

maria_s: I'll send Acme the temporary header workaround and ask them to switch to legacy formatter. Also asked for their top 3 failing request-ids so raj can trace. Will update thread when we have rollback status. :eyes:

raj_engine: I'll start the hotfix now and post progress. If we find the serializer bug is a one-liner revert, we can ship a patch and do a fast rollback within the hour.

maria_s: thanks — notifying customer that we're working it as a Sev 2 and will follow up with ETA.

acme_ops_jai: appreciate the quick attention. We'll flip to the header workaround and send sample request-ids in 10m.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from olivia_prod, :robot_face: from deploy-bot)
